name: ANIGMA Byte
detailed_description:
ANIGMA Byte is a tense and dynamic game that challenges your reaction and coordination. You are the last byte on whose digital shoulders rests the fate of the entire operating system. A critical error has caused chaos in the simulation, turning everything upside down. Your mission is to complete 13 challenging but exciting levels filled with treacherous obstacles. Time is playing against you, so act quickly and decisively!

Gameplay:

Parkour in an altered reality: The world of the game is inverted, and you will have to adapt to the constantly changing conditions. Dodge traps, cross chasms and maneuver through confusing mazes.

Gravity is under your control: Unique gravity control mechanics add a twist to the gameplay. With a single mouse click (left or right button) you can change the direction of gravity, allowing you to walk on the ceiling, avoid obstacles and find unconventional solutions.

Jump to the rescue: The spacebar is your faithful companion in this dangerous journey. Use jumps to cross chasms, dodge flying objects and reach hard-to-reach platforms.

Race against time: Each level must be completed as fast as possible. Compete with yourself and strive for new records.

Intuitive controls: Simple and clear controls allow you to quickly get used to the game and concentrate on the main thing - survival. If you suddenly forget which keys are responsible for what, press F1 for a hint.

13 levels of increasing difficulty: Each new level increases in difficulty, introducing new types of obstacles and traps that require more and more dexterity and reaction speed.

Exciting atmosphere: Minimalistic but stylish design and dynamic music create a unique atmosphere of tension and excitement.

Story:

Your operating system has suffered a critical failure that has caused total chaos. You are the last functioning byte, and only you can restore order. Complete all 13 levels of challenges to restart your system and save the digital world from destruction.

ANIGMA Byte is a test for your nerves and reflexes. Are you ready to take on the challenge?

Controls:

Space - jump

F1 - recall control keys

LKM / PKM - Change gravity

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: 64-bit Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-3570K or AMD FX-8310
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 670 / GeForce GTX 1050 / AMD Radeon HD 7870
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 200 MB available space
